name: ZCA_RECOMMENDATION_FEEDBACK
description: This table captures feedback from recommendations, such as recommendations dismissed, viewed or acted_on.

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_SOURCE_TYPE
columns.description: Recommendation source type such as SALES_INSIGHTS AI_OBJECT_HINTS SALES_SUGGESTIONS

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_SOURCE_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Recommendation source sub type such as ACTIVITY_EFFECTIVENESS,CONTACT_VALIDATION,hintCode vallue

columns.name: RECOMMENDATION_CONTEXT
columns.description: Recommendation context provides info on which recommendation was generated, it stores hash value equivalent.

columns.name: FEEDBACK_USER_PARTY_ID
columns.description: Resource PartyId of the user who generated recommendation feedback

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
